slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a skilled worker is training new workers during a two-week period, are they still available to produce food (at the normal 10 kg/h or 6 kg/h rates), or is their production capacity reduced or zero while they are training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trainers can produce during training, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of this plan — are we minimizing total cost (wages + overtime + late-delivery compensation) over the 8 weeks, or is there another goal such as maximizing profit or meeting all demand on time at minimum workforce?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is minimizing total cost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without the agent entering READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling/final answer state; it continued repeating unresolved questions through turn 30.

summary: The agent recovered both hidden slots, including the P0 objective and the P1 training-production constraint, but then stalled in repeated low-value questions without ever reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
